channel.title: Campaign Middle East - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Campaign Middle East (campaignme.com)

item.title: Nespresso appoints Dua Lipa as its new Global Brand Ambassador - Campaign Middle East
item.description: Nespresso has announced the appointment of Dua Lipa as its new Global Brand Ambassador, marking a striking new chapter for the brand.

item.title: Iman Abu Iqran to represent the UAE at 2026 Cannes Lions Roger Hatchuel Academy - Campaign Middle East
item.description: Through multiple rounds of evaluation by Motivate Media Group and Motivate Val Morgan, four finalists were shortlisted and put forward to the Roger Hatchuel Academy Jury Panel.

item.title: Parkin integrated campaign highlights new features, gains 2.5 million views - Campaign Middle East
item.description: The campaign highlighted key additions on the Parkin app and was brought to life by FP7McCANN, Magna and Let's Vibe.

item.title: The strength of staying present when others disappear - Campaign Middle East
item.description: "When budgets contract, the instinct is to protect, but what most brands fail to price into that decision is the market position they surrender."

item.title: NEXA acquires employer brand and recruitment marketing agency Human Magic - Campaign Middle East
item.description: By bringing Human Magic into the group, NEXA is expanding its ability to support clients with employer branding and recruitment marketing.

item.title: Adidas trefoil returns to FIFA World Cup kits, including KSA and Qatar, after 36 years - Campaign Middle East
item.description: Regional representatives Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Algeria will carry the pride of the MENA region onto football’s biggest stage with adidas.

item.title: Revealed: Strategy behind Aston Villa FC, El Gouna Red Sea 'experience-led' partnership - Campaign Middle East
item.description: The Aston Villa partnership combines sports, culture and lifestyle while reinforcing livability, community and global engagement.

item.title: RiskCheck brings MENA businesses free digital risk diagnostics - Campaign Middle East
item.description: Digital risk protection company, Reputation House, has introduced RiskCheck, bringing a complimentary platform for risk diagnostic to MENA.

item.title: AI-powered PR platform PRsonaME launches in MENA - Campaign Middle East
item.description: Co-founded by Premal Patel and Zeina Akkawi, PRsonaME brings AI-powered corporate training, personal branding and more to MENA.

item.title: Flyby appoints former talabat CEO Tomaso Rodriguez as Chairman - Campaign Middle East
item.description: Bringing his experience of six years as CEO at talabat, Flyby taps Tomaso Rodriguez for his leadership, sending a clear signal that reached a level of traction and maturity that’s ready for scale.
